Limit[n=15]
  Sort[keys=orders.order_date ASC, orders.total_price DESC, orders.id ASC]
    Project[orders.id AS id, orders.cust_id AS cust_id, orders.order_status AS order_status, orders.total_price AS total_price, orders.order_date AS order_date]
      Filter[orders.order_date >= '1995-01-01' AND orders.order_status = 'O']
        Scan[orders]
